Backlog item: Build an App Store–quality, colorful, offline-ready, mo...

Build an App Store–quality, colorful, offline-ready, mobile-first interactive learning game in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript (plus a manifest.json so it can be added to a phone or iPad Home Screen like a native app). Design it with a cheerful pastel-and-candy UI, smooth 60fps CSS animations, rounded 3D tactile buttons, viewport meta tag, touch-action: manipulation, no accidental double-tap zoom, and large thumb-friendly tap targets (at least 52x52px).
Include a custom animated chibi anime-style mascot (drawn in crisp layered SVG with blinking eyes, idle bounce, happy jump, and starry-eyed celebration poses), a Level Selector at the top with 4 age levels (Level 1: Ages 4–6, Level 2: Ages 7–9, Level 3: Ages 10–12, Level 4: Challenge Mode), and two modes:
Word Builder & Spelling: Level 1 has 3-letter CVC words with big picture emojis (CAT, DOG, SUN, HAT, PIG, FOX, CUP, BUS, BEE, OWL) using tap-to-place letter tiles; Level 2 has 4–5 letter everyday words with picture clues (STAR, FROG, APPLE, TRAIN, SMILE, CLOUD, TIGER, OCEAN); Level 3 has 6–8 letter vocabulary words with definitions as clues (PLANET, DOLPHIN, RAINBOW, JOURNEY, MYSTERY, VOLCANO); Level 4 has scrambled challenge words with a 30-second streak timer.
Math Quest: Level 1 has visual adding and subtracting (numbers 1–10) where animated counting icons (apples, cupcakes, stars, gems) appear on stage—and for subtraction, subtracted items hop/fade away visually so a 5-year-old can count what remains—with 4 big colorful answer buttons; Level 2 has two-digit addition/subtraction (10–50) with a visual number-line hint button; Level 3 has multiplication and division (up to 100); Level 4 has missing-number puzzles (e.g., ? + 14 = 32).
Add genuine game polish: gentle wiggle + glowing hint on wrong taps instead of harsh error buzzers; a 5-question round progress bar with streak multipliers (2x, 3x stars) and a celebration reward chest every 5 questions; a My Buddies & Outfits shop modal where players spend earned stars to unlock 6 cute chibi anime characters/outfits (Kitsune Fox Girl, Space Astronaut, Magical Star Witch, Dino Hoodie Kid, Panda Knight, Mermaid Princess) and 4 animated sidekick pets (Baby Dragon, Mochi Cat, Cloud Bunny, Starry Owl) saved in localStorage; and cheerful Web Audio API marimba/chime sound effects plus SpeechSynthesis voice narration triggered safely on user tap (with a top-corner Mute toggle).
Finally, create ~/.local/share/applications/learning-world.desktop pointing to index.html in Firefox, ensure git branch is main, set origin to https://github.com (update remote if origin already exists), commit all files, and git push -u origin main.

Work in the current worktree when code changes are clearly required.
If the request is a question, analysis, opinion, explanation, or review request, inspect the project if useful and answer in Markdown without editing files. Your final reply is that answer, in the user's language, never a note that no change was needed.
Only modify files when the request explicitly asks for implementation or when a concrete code change is necessary to satisfy it.
Preview verification requires application_ready for the current source and environment revisions; browser_ready alone is transport state. A blocking compiler error or HTTP 500 returns immediately with its diagnostic.
